_doc: Stage-2 mlcal spec: couple the walk-forward pre-fight Elo into engine v3's per-fight knobs through tools/mlcal_hooks/elo_skill.js, tuned on top of a fixed candidate (python3 tools/mlcal.py tune --spec tools/mlcal_spec_engine3_elo.json --fixed data/derived/mlcal_candidates.json#1).
